subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.answer: Cell division making two cells with the same DNA

steps: Mitosis makes two identical cells from one.

items.prompt: Do the two cells from mitosis have the same DNA?

steps: Mitosis produces cells with identical DNA.

items.prompt: What does mitosis let an organism do?

steps: New cells allow growth and repair.

items.answer: When cells become specialized into different types
Muscle cell (or nerve, skin, blood cell)

steps: Muscle, nerve, and skin cells are specialized types.

items.prompt: How does mitosis help heal a cut?
items.answer: It makes new cells to replace damaged ones

steps: New cells from mitosis repair the wound.

items.prompt: Do cells from mitosis start out specialized?

steps: They become specialized later through differentiation.

items.prompt: Why are both mitosis and differentiation needed?
items.answer: Mitosis makes cells and differentiation gives them jobs

steps: Both are needed to build a complex organism.

items.prompt: Can one fertilized egg become a whole organism?

steps: Through mitosis and differentiation it builds the organism.

items.prompt: What makes two identical cells become different cell types?

items.answer: It makes more cells, so the organism gets bigger

steps: More cells from mitosis means growth.

items.prompt: Describe how a fertilized egg becomes a complex organism.
items.answer: It divides by mitosis into many cells that differentiate into specialized types

steps: Mitosis plus differentiation builds the organism.

items.prompt: Why do skin cells need to keep dividing throughout life?
items.answer: To replace old and damaged skin cells

steps: Ongoing mitosis maintains and repairs the skin.

items.prompt: What would happen without differentiation, even with lots of mitosis?
items.answer: All cells would be the same, with no specialized types

steps: Without differentiation there would be no specialized cells.

items.prompt: Use a model to show the roles of mitosis and differentiation in development.
items.answer: One cell divides by mitosis into many cells, which differentiate into muscle, nerve, and other cells

steps: Mitosis provides cells; differentiation specializes them.
